picks.title: Agora Says Initia Exploit Hit Third-Party Product Using AUSD
picks.summary: Ethereum records show 1.4 million AUSD left a bridge adapter, while Agora says it has no smart contracts deployed on Initia.

picks.title: Agora Freezes AUSD Account Linked to Initia Exploit
picks.summary: Agora says it has no contracts on Initia; the targeted Ethereum account had already swapped 1.4 million AUSD for ETH.

picks.title: Initia Halts L1 and Rollups After Reported Mint Exploit
picks.summary: Analyst Spreek estimated $2.6 million had been cashed out; Ethereum records show stablecoin swaps and a later 1,135.5 ETH transfer.

picks.title: Netanyahu Considering Crypto Plan to Dodge Banking Sanctions on Israel
picks.summary: Days before Israel’s election, Netanyahu said he has asked for a blockchain plan in case banks are hit with sanctions, and told Israelis to prepare for a rainy day after Trump.
